description: Update a subscriber list's name, description, or privacy. Only the provided fields are changed. A public list's name is shown to subscribers in the email preference center, and making a list public lets subscribers join it there.

allowMemberUnsubscribe.description: Allow existing private-list members to unsubscribe in email preferences. Defaults false on creation; omission preserves on update, false disables. No effect on public lists. Does not allow joining or rejoining private lists.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

description.description: New list description. Pass null to clear it.

name: update_list

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_list` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

list.description: The list record returned by Sequenzy.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
